episodes.title: 1 km² of Floor Space
episodes.summary: It's the 100th anniversary of Can Mosques, a restaurant in the Raval neighborhood of Barcelona. Alex is about to give great news, but it doesn't turn out as expected.

episodes.title: 15 Weekly Payments
episodes.summary: Àlex and Marta meet with the squatters to prevent the Eurohome investment fund from taking over the building, but their plan makes David suspicious.

episodes.title: 70 Drug Flats
episodes.summary: Marta meets with Claire at Eurohome to gather information. The power goes out in the restaurant. The plan isn't working, but David decides to help.

episodes.title: 38 languages
episodes.summary: Àlex starts squatting in more properties in the neighborhood with the help of David and Souhail, but they soon raise the suspicions of Lluís and Lisa.

episodes.title: 260 societies
episodes.summary: Lisa and Lluís question Àlex, Marta, and David's plans to save Can Mosques, but Àlex has already lost control.

episodes.title: 42 Landmarks
episodes.summary: Àlex faces possible charges of criminal conspiracy. The family gets one last chance to stand up to Eurohome and prevent Can Mosques from disappearing.
